capabilities: Convert images to WebP and compress them
Upload files to an S3-compatible bucket
Insert Markdown image links into notes
Overlay text or logo watermarks with live preview
extras: Previously named Watermark Bucket Uploader; existing installations and settings continue to work. Credentials are stored locally in the plugin data folder and no telemetry is collected. Requires Obsidian 1.6.6 or later; desktop and mobile supported.
motivation: The author wanted pasting an image to be zero-friction while keeping images on storage the user owns and controls.
problem: Images pasted into notes stay as local vault files with no public URL, so notes and published pages carry large files and cannot reference hosted images.

relations.evidence: Works with any S3-compatible storage — Cloudflare R2, AWS S3, MinIO, Backblaze B2, and more.
Works with any S3-compatible storage — Cloudflare R2, AWS S3, MinIO, Backblaze B2, and more.

requires.name: S3 access key and secret key

summary: Uploader that intercepts pasted or dropped images, converts and compresses them, uploads them to an S3-compatible bucket and inserts a Markdown link.
